description: Other names to try, in order, when the recipe's own wording does not find the food. Plain synonyms first (what a cook would also call it), then the USDA SR28 wording. Synonyms are allowed to miss: each miss is one attempt toward the retry cap. Only foods that are the same food are listed; where the recipe leaves the type open (plain 'milk', 'vegetable oil', 'greek yogurt', 'sea salt') there is deliberately no alias, so the ingredient ends as unknown rather than guessed.
